# RAS Group LLC

> A Tigard-based CPA firm specializing in personalized tax, accounting, and financial services for individuals, businesses, and non-profits.

RAS Group LLC is a full-service accounting firm located in Tigard, Oregon, serving the Portland Metro area. The firm offers comprehensive tax preparation, business accounting with QuickBooks integration, non-profit accounting services including 990 filings, and individual tax planning with IRS representation.

- CPA Services
- Tax Preparation
- Individual Tax Services

- Roy Rogers

## Service Lines

- [Individual Tax Services](https://www.rasgroupllc.com/individual): Individual tax returns, IRS representation, estate planning, and retirement planning services
- [Business Tax & Accounting](https://www.rasgroupllc.com/business): Business tax services, accounting, payroll processing, and financial planning with QuickBooks integration
- [Non-Profit Accounting](https://www.rasgroupllc.com/non-profit): Non-profit accounting services including 990 returns, audits, and financial statements
